summary: @nebula.js/locale 0.6.2 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package ships a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it via `execFileSync` to run a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 728KB single-line, heavily obfuscated blob using hex-mangled identifiers (`_0xNNNN`), a rotating string-array (`WV8StW` shift routine), and an opaque numeric/character table. Routing execution through a freshly downloaded alternate runtime bypasses Node-based supply-chain scanners that only trace the Node module graph. The `package.json` presents the package as `@nebula.js/locale` by `QlikTech International AB` with repo `qlik-oss/nebula.js`, but the upstream qlik-oss/nebula.js source tree contains neither `setup.mjs` nor `math_init.js` nor a `preinstall` script — the dropper machinery is grafted onto legitimate-looking Qlik metadata to impersonate the qlik-oss scope. Installing this version triggers automatic execution of concealed code on the installer's machine on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
